title: Scroll Swap - Open App
meta_description: scroll swap opens a Scroll-network DEX route for wallet-based token trades, slippage review, and explorer verification before you sign.
hero_h2: Exchange tokens on Scroll with clear routing
hero_lead: Scroll Swap sends users straight to a Scroll-native DEX flow where they can connect a wallet, choose a pair, review slippage, and confirm on-chain.
what_is: Scroll Swap is an app-first route for exchanging tokens on Scroll through Zebra, a decentralized exchange built on Scroll. Scroll is EVM-compatible, so confirm network, token contracts, and transactions with Scrollscan before signing.

how.d: Use the button to enter Zebra's trading interface from the verified destination.
Connect an EVM wallet and confirm it is set to Scroll Mainnet before selecting assets.
Pick the input and output tokens, then verify symbols against contract addresses when needed.
Check price impact, slippage, minimum received, approvals, and the final wallet prompt.

points.p: Zebra's docs describe a permissionless DEX built on Scroll; the CTA opens its app for wallet-based trades.
Review amount out, route quality, price impact, slippage tolerance, and minimum received before approving token spending.
After confirmation, use Scrollscan to review status, token transfers, and contract addresses.

faq.a: scroll swap is the user intent to exchange tokens on Scroll; this page routes to Zebra's app for an on-chain DEX trade and keeps the key safety checks visible.

faq.q: Is scroll swap the official Scroll app?
faq.a: No. Scroll is the network, and Zebra is a third-party DEX built on Scroll; verify app.zebra.xyz before connecting a wallet.

faq.q: Which wallet do I need for scroll swap?
faq.a: Use an EVM wallet set to Scroll Mainnet; Scroll docs list chain ID 534352 and ETH as the currency symbol.

faq.q: Why can a scroll swap fail?
faq.a: Common causes are too little liquidity, tight slippage, price movement before execution, insufficient ETH for gas, or selecting the wrong token contract.

faq.q: How should I check a scroll swap after signing?
faq.a: Open the transaction hash on Scrollscan and review the status, logs, and token transfers; wallet balances can lag behind the explorer.

footer_note: Not the official app. Verify the destination domain before connecting a wallet; educational content, not financial advice.
